# Which account should you spend first?

> Free retirement withdrawal calculator. Enter your taxable, traditional and Roth balances, spending and Social Security; it compares withdrawal orders and bracket-filling Roth conversions year by year under 2026 tax rules and shows what each leaves you after tax. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
